subject: Private Offer renewal & commitment increase for CloudWave Analytics
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@amazon.com>; AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer renewal & commitment increase for CloudWave Analytics

Hi Tom / AWS Marketplace team,

Following up on CloudWave's upcoming renewal (current private offer AMZ-PO-12345). They want to move from a $250k annual commitment to a $400k annual commit for the term starting 2026-07-01, and extend the term from 12 months to 24 months. The ask:

- Issue an updated private offer that reflects the new annual commitment ($400k) and 24-month term
- Include the previously agreed 10% volume discount and a one-time onboarding credit we negotiated (apply to first invoice)
- Make it PO-ready so CloudWave procurement can accept via the Marketplace flow (we need executed PO PDF for our records)

Attached is the previous private offer we referenced. Can you confirm what the next steps are and whether we need to provide any additional SOW/contract language? CloudWave's procurement contact is included on this thread (Lisa) — they'd like to close by the end of May if possible.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference

Attachments: previous-private-offer.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@amazon.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>; Lisa Barnes <lisa.barnes@cloudwave.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer renewal & commitment increase for CloudWave Analytics

Vanessa — thanks for the details. We can absolutely create an updated private offer for CloudWave. Next steps and items we need:

1) Confirm the exact billing cadence (annual upfront vs. annual invoiced).
2) Confirm the legal entity on the PO (name and billing address).
3) We will generate a new private offer ID (planned: AMZ-PO-12345-R1) and share a marketplace link you can forward to procurement for acceptance.

I drafted a quick checklist for you and CloudWave:
- Billing cadence: Annual upfront (preferred)
- Term: 24 months starting 2026-07-01
- Commit: $400,000/year
- Discounts/credits: 10% volume discount, onboarding credit $20,000 applied to invoice #1
\We can also attach the SOW as a supporting doc but the Marketplace acceptance is typically done against the private offer PDF. I attached the preliminary private offer export for your records.
\If you can confirm billing cadence and PO legal entity today, I can push the offer through and have the offer link to you by EOD tomorrow.
\Regards,
Tom Reed
AWS Marketplace — Team

Attachments: AWS-PO-12345.pdf (Marketplace export)

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Private Offer renewal & commitment increase for CloudWave Analytics — internal approval request

Hi Finance team —

Looping you in for an expedited approval. Summary of changes for CloudWave:
- Annual commit: $400,000 (previously $250,000)
- Term: 24 months (2026-07-01 through 2028-06-30)
- Agreed pricing: 10% volume discount applied to token usage; one-time onboarding credit $20k
\Estimated invoice schedule (annual upfront):
- Year 1 invoice: $360,000 (after 10% discount), less $20,000 onboarding credit applied to invoice 1 = $340,000 net due
- Year 2 invoice: $360,000
\Please confirm whether we need a purchase order number on our end and whether you can pre-approve the revenue recognition treatment for the larger commit so we don't block CloudWave's acceptance. I attached the draft amendment (RW-Amendment-v1.docx) that we'll have the customer sign; that should be the supporting doc for the Marketplace private offer.

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Renewals, North America
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RW-Amendment-v1.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Private Offer renewal & commitment increase for CloudWave Analytics — internal approval request

Quick note — do we have room to request a one-time make-good or additional promotional credit from AWS for the expansion? If AWS is open to a small credit (we'd ask for 5% of Year 1 net or a $15k credit), it makes the transition easier for the customer and helps our CS/Renewals targets.
\If that's plausible, I can coordinate the ask with our partner manager and include it in the negotiation thread.

Tom — thanks. Per CloudWave procurement we will proceed with:
- Billing cadence: Annual upfront
- Legal entity for PO: CloudWave Analytics, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) — billing address on file (Lisa will confirm if any updates are needed)

I've attached the signed amendment (DocuSign envelope completed by the customer) — please use this as the supporting SOW. Please take the updated private offer live and share the Marketplace acceptance link with Lisa (procurement@cloudwave.com) so they can accept and trigger the Marketplace invoice flow.

Also, Sean has asked if AWS can provide a one-time promotional credit of $15k against Year 1. If that's something you can approve, please reflect it in the offer or confirm the credit mechanism so we can communicate it to CloudWave.

Thanks for the quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
